name: Practice: Reading Music While Playing
equipment: A piano or keyboard and simple sheet music
instructions: Find a very simple piece of sheet music (even a few-note beginner exercise) and try to follow along as you play.
Go slowly, note by note if needed -- fluent sight-reading takes months of regular practice to build.
It is completely fine to lean on your ear alongside the notation at this stage; both skills reinforce each other.
Revisit yesterday's notation video as a reference.
